manualReview.summary: The network I/O and IPC point is supported. The other point introduces a mechanism: controlling subprocesses by executing event loops. Unit 18 states creating/managing event loops and the asynchronous APIs they provide; it does not explicitly state that generated execution mechanism. Technical acceptance is preserved and does not settle meaning.

points.reason: The generated execution predicate is attached to event loops, whereas running in the quote describes subprocesses. The added causal means is not explicit in this own unit.
